body: Worker reminder (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-10, learned from my own miss on w-c2422f97c77d evaluation eb87d9bf): until w-539ea7e8b506's fix is live on the running host, follow live-workaround-eval-submission for EVERY acceptance evaluation. After termal_evaluate_acceptance, make no tracker write in that turn and hold the turn OPEN with termal_wait_delegations on the evaluator delegation until it submits; only then report. Do not use termal_resume_after_delegations and end the turn. Ending the turn produced a submission 409, "the work no longer names the evaluated source root under its claim", which discarded an all-pass verdict.
